uranus-taurus.before: The same paycheck reaches the end of the month sooner, but the household keeps using the budget that once made everything feel manageable. With Uranus in Taurus, abrupt change reaches material arrangements designed to stay dependable, exposing the gap between a stable routine and a workable one. Taurus holds on through repetition and tangible proof, so the disruption becomes undeniable when the total on the page no longer matches what daily life costs.
